verdict.rationale: LangGraph is a Python library invoked via stream/astream/invoke calls with no UI dependency, and ships a CLI plus 'Agent Server' that exposes REST endpoints for runs/threads, backed by production-grade checkpointers (e.g. PostgresSaver) and durable execution that resumes after failures — all standard for scripted/CI automation. missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g. GitHub Actions), and no independent hands-on report confirming headless CI usage specifically.
